Further enquiries concerning Jules KUPON show that prior
to the issuance of a Rumanian passport (No.860786/416) on 10
September 1931 by the Rumanian Legation at Brussels, another
passport had been issued to him, by the same Legation on 4 August
1926 (No.475381).

It appears furthermore that during his stay in Japan the
Rumanian Legation at Tokio delivered to him a certificate of
nationality, which most probably is still in his possession.

On 15 (21 ?) September Jules and his brother José, (the lat-
ter accompanied by his wife, who is said to have still a Belgian
passport) left Japan by the "Katori Maru", having been expelled
from that country on account of various thefts, committed by them
in Tokio, Yokohama and Kobe. It appears to have been their in-
tention to proceed afterwards from Shanghai to Canada.

The passport, issued to Jules in 1931, was sent by him on its
expiration, to the Rumanian Legation at Tokio, together with the
money necessary for a new passport. This passport however was
returned to him with a request for further particulars, which he
has so far failed to produce. It is to be surmised therefore that
Jules, apart from his declaration of nationality, possesses still
the Rumanian passport mentioned above.

His application for a Hungarian passport with the Netherlands
Consulate General appears to be unfounded and will not be enter-
tained.

The last address given by Jules Kutron was 132 Rte Vallon,
room 22; his brother José was said to live at 183 in the same
street.

20 November 1933.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 5411
日期 33年11月23日

对朱尔斯·库蓬（Jules KUPON）的进一步查询显示，在罗马尼亚驻布鲁塞尔公使馆于1931年9月10日向其签发罗马尼亚护照（编号860786/416）之前，该公使馆曾于1926年8月4日向其签发过另一本护照（编号475381）。

此外，似乎在其逗留日本期间，罗马尼亚驻东京公使馆向其签发了一份国籍证明书，该文件很可能仍由其持有。

9月15日（21日？），朱尔斯与其弟何塞（José，后者由其妻子陪同，据称其妻仍持有比利时护照）乘坐“香取丸”（Katori Maru）离开日本，他们因在东京、横滨和神户犯下多起盗窃案而被该国驱逐出境。看来他们打算随后从上海前往加拿大。

朱尔斯于1931年获得的护照在到期后，由其连同办理新护照所需的费用一并寄往罗马尼亚驻东京公使馆。然而，该公使馆将护照退回，并要求提供更多详细信息，但他至今未能提供。因此可以推测，除了其国籍声明外，朱尔斯仍持有上述提到的罗马尼亚护照。

他向荷兰总领事馆申请匈牙利护照一事似乎毫无根据，将不予受理。

朱尔斯·库特龙（Jules Kutron）提供的最后地址是瓦隆路（Rte Vallon）132号22室；据说其弟何塞住在同一路段183号。

1933年11月20日。

November 8 33.

My dear Steptoe,

I forward herewith a photograph of Jules Kutron
which I have received from the local Netherlands Consu-
late-Général.

Kutron claims to be a Hungarian subject but the
Hungarian papers in his possession do not prove that this
is so. He is in possession of a Roumanian passport issued
to him at Brussels (No. 880786) on September 10, 1931.

Kutron was recently deported from Japan for shoplift
ing. On October 20, 1933 he was charged before the Special
District Court for shoplifting and uttering a fradulently
altered banknote and was sentenced to four months imprison-
me . This sentence was suspended for two years.

According to the local Netherlands Consulate, Kutron
was born in Roumania on August 25, 1900 and his wife,
Julie Vincent, was originally of Belgian nationality.
They are at present residing at No. 183 Route Vallon.

Yours sincerely,

H.N.Steptoe, Esq.,
British Consulate-General.
pages.zh:
33年11月8日。

亲爱的斯特普托（Steptoe）：

现随函附上我从本地荷兰总领事馆收到的朱尔斯·库特龙的照片。

库特龙声称是匈牙利臣民，但他持有的匈牙利文件并不能证明这一点。他持有一本于1931年9月10日在布鲁西亚签发的罗马尼亚护照（编号 880786）。

库特龙最近因商店行窃被日本驱逐出境。1933年10月20日，他在特区法院被控商店行窃及使用经欺诈变造的钞票，并被判处四个月监禁。该判决缓刑两年。

据本地荷兰领事馆称，库特龙于1900年8月25日出生于罗马尼亚，其妻朱莉·文森特（Julie Vincent）原籍比利时。他们目前居住在瓦隆路183号。

此致
敬礼，

H.N.斯特普托先生，
英国总领事馆。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY 5411 S.2. Station）
Date November 2, 1933

Subject (in full) Enquiry re Jules Kutron

Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by A.D. Everett

With reference to the attached confidential document from
the Netherlands Consulate-General on the subject of one Jules
Kutron or Kurton and to the endorsement made by the Officer i/c
Special Branch asking for short comment, I have to report that
enquiries have been instituted regarding the antecedents of
this individual.

The Political Section of the French Police has been
approached but, according to Mr Serly, the only information in
the possession of the French Police respecting Kutron is that
embodied in the attached document, a copy of which was also
received by them from the Netherlands Consulate.

From perusal of the attached communication one gathers
that there is a suspicion that the person calling himself
Jules Kutron or Kurton may not be the man to whom the
identification papers mentioned were originally issued. There
appears some justification for this suspicion when one considers
the fact of the entries and erasures on this man's documents,
which, to quote the Netherlands Consulate, "do not make the
impression of having been made in an official manner." Then
again, none of the photographs on the papers resembles
strikingly the person representing himself to be Jules Kutron.

I consider the possibility of Kutron being an agent of
the IIIrd International rather remote. Kutron gives me the
impression of being purely and simply a crook.

He was recently deported from Japan not, as he explains,
for taking photographs in a prohibited area, but for shoplifting.

主题（全称） 关于朱尔斯·库特龙的查询

制作人 D.S. 琼斯 转呈人 A.D. 埃弗雷特

鉴于附件中来自荷兰总领事馆关于一名叫朱尔斯·库特龙（Jules Kutron）或库顿（Kurton）之人的机密文件，以及特别股主管警官要求简要评论的批注，本人谨报告已对该人的背景进行了调查。

已联系法国警察政治科，但据瑟利（Serly）先生称，法国警方掌握的关于库特龙的唯一信息即包含在附件文件中，该文件的副本也是他们从荷兰领事馆收到的。

通过阅读附件函件可知，有人怀疑自称朱尔斯·库特龙或库顿的人可能并非最初获得所述身份证明文件的那个人。考虑到此人文件上的涂改和擦除痕迹——引用荷兰领事馆的话说，“不像是以官方方式制作的”——这种怀疑似乎有一定依据。此外，文件上的照片均与自称朱尔斯·库特龙的人没有显著相似之处。

我认为库特龙是第三国际特工的可能性微乎其微。库特龙给我的印象纯粹是个骗子。

他最近被日本驱逐出境，原因并非如他所解释的是因为在禁区拍照，而是因为商店行窃。

不久前，库特龙购买了一批廉价小饰品以便加价转售。他显然是个能言善辩的流氓，因为有报告称他成功地将许多

Kutron appeared before the Special District Court on October 20
to answer a charge of Shoplifting and one of Uttering a
fraudently
~~fraudently~~ altered Bank-note.

It appears that on the previous day he entered the store
of Messrs Lane Crawford in Nanking Road and tendered a 100 Mark
Bank-note in payment of a purchase. The date on the bank-note,
which was issued in 1909 and was consequently valueless, had
been altered to read 1929. When the shop assistant's back was
turned Kutron stole a pair of stockings which he hid under his
overcoat.

For these two offences he was sentenced to four months'
imprisonment; sentence to be suspended for two years.

He is now reported to be residing at No. 183 Route Vallon.

On 26 October 1933 a person called at the Office of the Nether-
lands Consulate General, temporarily in charge of Hungarian
Jose.
Interests, who stated to be Jules KUTRON, profession a shoemaker,
born at Nagyvarad (Grosswaarden), 25 July 1900, living at 38 Rte
Vallon, nationality Hungarian, holder of a Hungarian passport
1004 No.B.087804 issued at Madrid 2-XI-1924, bearing the following
visas. 3-XI'24 Italian visa issued at Madrid
4-XII'24 French Visa issued at Milan
1-XII'24 visa for Haiti
20-VII'25 Mexican visa issued at St.Nazaire
13-X-'25 an annotation from the Hungarian Consulate in
Mexico (without any stamps or seals) for travelling in the
interior of Mexico.
He also showed a letter from the Hungarian Consul General at
Marseille dated 28-1-25,No.214/1925 authorising him to embark
on any vessel leaving that port.
From other papers it was shown that he served on the "Josiah
Macy" from 15-2-26 till 15-3-26.
According to a paper issued by the Hamburg Police he registered
there on 29-3-26 and was said to live at the house of a certain
Nachmann.
On 2-4-26 the Hungarian Legation at Berlin issued a certificate
No.4553, stating that Kutron had applied for a passport, but
that pending the issue of a passport by the competent authorities,
this certificate was issued to him, which did not imply however
that he was recognised as a Hungarian subject.
The Hungarian Legation Brussels requests in a document, dated
18-4-26 that a "permission de séjour temporaire" be issued to
Kurten or Kutron.
On 12 August 1927 the USA Dept.of Labor at Washington wrote to
Kutron (letter No.55663/637),129 Rue du Midi, Brussels, that it
had requested the District Director of Immigration, Galveston,
Texas

1933年10月26日，一人来到暂时负责匈牙利利益的荷兰总领事馆办公室，自称朱尔斯·库特龙（Jules KUTRON），职业鞋匠，1900年7月25日出生于纳吉瓦拉德（Nagyvarad，即格罗斯瓦尔登 Grosswaarden），居住于瓦隆路38号，国籍匈牙利，持有1924年11月2日在马德里签发的匈牙利护照，编号1004 B.087804，载有以下签证：1924年11月3日意大利签证，马德里签发；1924年12月4日法国签证，米兰签发；1924年12月1日海地签证；1925年7月20日墨西哥签证，圣纳泽尔签发；1925年10月13日匈牙利驻墨西哥领事馆的一条注释（无任何印章或图章），用于在墨西哥内地旅行。
他还出示了一封马赛匈牙利总领事于1925年1月28日发出的第214/1925号信函，授权他搭乘任何离开该港口的船只。
其他文件显示，他于1926年2月15日至1926年3月15日期间在“乔赛亚·梅西”号（Josiah Macy）上服役。
根据汉堡警方出具的一份文件，他于1926年3月29日在那里登记，据说住在一个名叫纳赫曼（Nachmann）的人家里。
1926年4月2日，匈牙利驻柏林公使馆签发第4553号证书，声明库特龙已申请护照，但在主管当局签发护照之前，先向他签发此证书，但这并不意味着承认他为匈牙利臣民。
匈牙利驻布鲁塞尔公使馆在一份 dated 1926年4月18日的文件中，请求为库尔滕（Kurten）或库特龙签发“临时居留许可”。
1927年8月12日，华盛顿美国劳工部致信库特龙（信件编号55663/637），地址为布鲁塞尔米迪街129号，称已要求德克萨斯州加尔维斯顿区移民局局长

Texas, to forward Kurton's passport to the American Consul at
Rotterdam, with instructions to retain same until called for by
Kurton upon his arrival at that port as a member of the crew
of the "Josiah Macy".

According to Kurton, the passport referred to above, was the one
he showed now.

Kurton also showed a letter from the "Chargeurs Réunis" at Buda-
pest, No. 112/Ch, dated 8 Aug. 1932 informing him that the passage
price for a voyage from Marseille to Singapore would cost
3718.60 French francs .

Kurton furthermore showed a green booklet, International Agree-
ment Form V.44, Personal Card, Identification No. 1090/3 showing
that he had been treated in Hongkong on 6 June 1933, 29 Aug. 1933
at Tokyo, 27 Sept. 1933 at Shanghai.

Many of the documents shown contain entries and erasions which
do not make the impression of having been made in an official
manner, none of the photographs on his papers are clear or
resemble strikingly the person who presented himself as Jules
Kurton.

At first Kurton stated that after leaving Mexico in 1926 he
stayed all the time in Belgium, where he said he was working in
the shoefactory "Hofman", at Brussels. His papers show however
that he, before leaving for Singapore, was in various countries
in Europe.

He also said that he lost the passport issued to him by the
Hungarian Consul at Brussels and that he travelled to Batavia
only on his sailor's papers, a statement which is hardly be-
lievable.

From information at hand Jules Kutron was born in Roumania on
25 August 1900 and a Roumanian passport was issued to him at
Brussels (No. 830786) on 10 September 1931. His brother Josef
Kutron however appears to have been born at Navrgarad on 17
February

德克萨斯州，将库顿的护照转交美国驻鹿特丹领事，并指示在该人作为“乔赛亚·梅西”号船员抵达该港口索取之前予以保留。

据库顿称，上述提到的护照就是他目前出示的那一本。

库顿还出示了一封布达佩斯“联合航运公司”（Chargeurs Réunis）的信函，编号112/Ch，日期为1932年8月8日，通知他从马赛到新加坡的航程票价为3718.60法郎。

库顿还出示了一本绿色小册子，《国际协定表格 V.44，个人卡片》，识别号1090/3，显示他曾于1933年6月6日在香港、1933年8月29日在东京、1933年9月27日在上海接受治疗。

许多出示的文件包含给人非官方制作印象的录入和擦除痕迹，他文件上的照片均不清晰，或与自称朱尔斯·库顿的人没有显著相似之处。

起初，库顿声称1926年离开墨西哥后，他一直待在比利时，并称在布鲁塞尔的“霍夫曼”（Hofman）鞋厂工作。然而，他的文件显示，在前往新加坡之前，他曾到过欧洲各国。

他还说，他丢失了匈牙利驻布鲁塞尔领事签发给他的护照，仅凭海员证件前往巴达维亚，这一说法几乎不可信。

根据手头资料，朱尔斯·库特龙于1900年8月25日出生于罗马尼亚，并于1931年9月10日在布鲁西亚获发罗马尼亚护照（编号 830786）。然而，其弟约瑟夫·库特龙似乎出生于纳夫尔加德（Navrgarad），日期为2月17日

pages.en:
CONFIDE

On 28 October 1933 the person calling himself Jules Kutron
presented himself again at the office of the Netherlands Consulate
General, where he was told to return with his brother and the
papers the latter is carrying. The brother was said to be
engaged in negotiating a contract for giving theatrical perfor-
mances as a dancer in Nanking, for which place he might have to
leave any moment.
The address of the brothers was now stated to be 132 Route Yallem,
room 22.
It appears that none of the Hungarian papers shown by Jules Kutron
state him to be a Hungarian subject, although they mention him
as being a resident of Hungary.
On 30 October Jules Kutron returned in the presence of his brother
Josef Kutron and the latter's wife. Josef Kutron is in possession
of a Hungarian passport A 064.366/366/1933 issued by the Hungarian
Legation at The Hague on 10 April 1933. He was born at Nagyvarad
(Germ.Grosswardein, Rum.Orasi Mari) on 17 February 1909, his wife
at Alost (Belgium) on 4 August 1894. They were married at
Budapest on 29 February 1932, registrar's deed No. 220, and while
in that city were living at VII Alsoerdosor 12. In the presence
of Jules they admitted that the latter had received a Rumanian
passport, and Jules thereupon no longer denied that he had travel-
led all the way from Europe without a passport. His Rumanian
passport he said had been despatched to the Rumanian Legation at
Tokio for extension, but his letters to the Legation had re-
mained unanswered. Inquiries are now being made as to the correct-
ness of this statement.

30 October 1933.

机密

1933年10月28日，自称朱尔斯·库特龙（Jules Kutron）的人再次前往荷兰总领事馆办公室，被告知需与其兄弟一同返回，并携带其兄弟所持文件。据称，其兄弟正就一份在南京以舞者身份进行戏剧表演的合同进行谈判，为此他可能随时需要离开该地。
此时，兄弟二人的住址申报为亚尔培路（Route Yallem）132号22室。
经查，朱尔斯·库特龙出示的匈牙利文件中，虽提及他为匈牙利居民，但均未表明其为匈牙利籍公民。
10月30日，朱尔斯·库特龙在其兄弟约瑟夫·库特龙（Josef Kutron）及弟媳陪同下返回。约瑟夫·库特龙持有一本匈牙利护照，号码为A 064.366/366/1933，由匈牙利驻海牙公使馆于1933年4月10日签发。他于1909年2月17日出生于纳吉瓦拉德（Nagyvarad，德语：Grosswardein，罗马尼亚语：Orasi Mari），其妻于1894年8月4日出生于阿洛斯特（Alost，比利时）。二人于1932年2月29日在布达佩斯结婚，登记契据编号220，在该市期间居住于VII Alsoerdosor 12号。在朱尔斯在场的情况下，他们承认后者曾获得一本罗马尼亚护照，朱尔斯随即不再否认其在无护照情况下从欧洲一路旅行至此的事实。他称其罗马尼亚护照已寄往罗马尼亚驻东京公使馆以办理延期，但其致该公使馆的信件未获回复。目前正就该陈述的真实性进行调查。

1933年10月30日。
